_comment_purpose: Sample loan/financing offers fixture for testing the loan-ranking pipeline. Offers are intentionally varied to exercise sorting, filtering, and edge-case logic.
_comment_structure: Top-level array of offer objects. Each: provider_name, apr, tenure_months, max_amount, min_amount, approval_probability (0-1), provider_reliability (0-1).
_comment_ranking: The ranking algorithm should consider: lower APR > higher approval_probability > higher provider_reliability. Hospital payment plan (0% APR) should typically rank #1.
_comment_integration: Load in tests via: json.load(open('tests/fixtures/loans/sample_loan_offers.json'))['offers']. Insert into 'loan_offers' collection with patient_id = 'PAT-TEST-001'.

offers._comment: Hospital payment plan — 0% APR, high reliability, but lower max amount and moderate approval odds
Fintech medical lender — competitive APR, high approval, newer provider so lower reliability score
Personal loan from traditional bank — moderate APR, high reliability, stricter approval
Specialized medical financing — mid-range APR, long tenure, decent approval
Medical credit card — highest APR (24.99%), easy approval, useful as a worst-case fallback option

_comment_test_assertions: APRs span from 0.0 to 24.99 — tests should verify sorting by APR ascending
Hospital plan (apr=0.0) should rank first under most ranking strategies
HealthCard (apr=24.99) should rank last despite highest approval probability
All approval_probability values are between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive
All provider_reliability values are between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive
